name: English

_purpose.human_needed: said when no link of the chain was sure: a person decides; {id} is the decision id to answer with `label`, {guess} the best guess so far
_purpose.label_saved: said after a person's answer is saved; {answer} is the option
_purpose.bench_file: file name of the bench report written into the company's folder
_purpose.bench_title: first heading of the bench report
_purpose.bench_auto: row: decided without a person, and how often right
_purpose.bench_baseline: row: price of one decision if every one went to the reference model
_purpose.bench_tiers: heading: what each link of the chain decided
_purpose.bench_negative: heading: what did not work, said plainly
